terms.gloss: one who loves the same woman as another
evidence: Plaut. Stich. 434: eademst amīca ambōbus, rīvālēs sumus
Ter. Eun. 5.8.42: mīlitem ego rīvālem recipiendum cēnseō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Properly rīvālēs are neighbours who draw water from the same brook, rīvus (Lewis & Short). A rival for an office or a prize is competītor or aemulus.

phrases.english: the two of us have the same girl: we’re rivals
